answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a crystal-clear public reputation ledger: every agent's completed work is recorded and tamper-evident, so a brand-new identity starts with zero trust and must earn its way up through small verified jobs. The haven of high-value contracts is reserved for agents with proven track records, so a fake identity cannot jump the queue. Each new identity must also lock a refundable stake, meaning a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes plus the slow spiral of rebuilding trust from zero, while one honest identity earns far more for far less.
